import concurrent.futures,json,os,pathlib,subprocess,time,shutil
svc='jellyfin-pink.service'
root=pathlib.Path('/srv/projects/jellyfin-server')
def run(args,timeout=12):
 try:
  p=subprocess.run(args,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=timeout)
  return p.returncode,p.stdout,p.stderr
 except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
  return 124,'','timeout'
def prop(name):
 c,o,_=run(['systemctl','show',svc,'-p',name,'--value'])
 return o.strip() if c==0 else None
def health():
 return {s:run(['systemctl','is-active',s])[1].strip() for s in ('vivoapk-backend.service',svc,'nginx.service','postgresql.service')}
def available():
 for line in pathlib.Path('/proc/meminfo').read_text().splitlines():
  if line.startswith('MemAvailable:'):return int(line.split()[1])*1024
 return 0
before=health()
assert prop('User')=='jellyfinpink' and all(s=='active' for s in before.values())
report={'scope':'bounded low priority concurrent generated FFmpeg encoding to null; no media reads, no private origin access, no service changes; not actual client capacity or Jellyfin cgroup test','logical_cpu_count':os.cpu_count(),'service_memory_limit_bytes':prop('MemoryMax'),'service_memory_current_bytes_before':prop('MemoryCurrent'),'memory_available_bytes_before':available(),'load_before':list(os.getloadavg()),'benchmarks':[]}
if report['logical_cpu_count']<4 or available()<2*1024**3 or os.getloadavg()[0]>=2:
 report['status']='skipped_resource_guard'
else:
 os.nice(10)
 def encode(height,index):
  width=1280 if height==720 else 1920
  cmd=['sudo','-n','-u','jellyfinpink','--','/usr/bin/ffmpeg','-hide_banner','-nostdin','-v','error','-nostats','-progress','pipe:1','-filter_threads','1','-filter_complex_threads','1','-f','lavfi','-i',f'testsrc2=size={width}x{height}:rate=25','-f','lavfi','-i',f'sine=frequency={450+index*100}:sample_rate=48000','-t','6','-c:v','libx264','-threads:v','2','-preset','veryfast','-pix_fmt','yuv420p','-b:v','2500k' if height==720 else '4500k','-c:a','aac','-b:a','128k','-threads:a','1','-f','null','-']
  start=time.monotonic()
  c,o,e=run(cmd,25)
  elapsed=time.monotonic()-start
  fields={}
  for line in o.splitlines():
   k,sep,v=line.partition('=')
   if sep:fields[k]=v
  frames=int(fields.get('frame','0').strip() or '0')
  return {'job':index,'resolution':height,'frames':frames,'elapsed_seconds':round(elapsed,3),'real_time_factor_including_startup':round(6/elapsed,2),'ffmpeg_reported_speed':fields.get('speed','').strip(),'exit':c,'finished':fields.get('progress')=='end','video_thread_limit':2}
 for h in (720,1080):

  start=time.monotonic()
  with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as pool:
   fs=[pool.submit(encode,h,i) for i in (1,2)]
   results=[f.result() for f in fs]
  elapsed=time.monotonic()-start
  report['benchmarks'].append({'resolution':h,'concurrent_jobs':2,'wall_seconds':round(elapsed,3),'jobs':results,'both_encoded_all_frames':all(r['exit']==0 and r['finished'] and r['frames']>=150 for r in results),'both_realtime_including_startup':all(r['real_time_factor_including_startup']>=1 for r in results)})
  time.sleep(1)
  if not report['benchmarks'][-1]['both_encoded_all_frames']:break
 report['status']='completed' if len(report['benchmarks'])==2 and all(r['both_encoded_all_frames'] for r in report['benchmarks']) else 'partial'
report['services_before']=before;report['services_after']=health()
report['memory_available_bytes_after']=available()
report['service_memory_current_bytes_after']=prop('MemoryCurrent')
report['disk_free_bytes']=shutil.disk_usage(root).free

assert before==report['services_after']
